name: Ligne 18
about: Line 18 of the Grand Paris Express on the plateau (ref/metro18/): the line's own lot, the parent of its lots, which share its master plan (lots/ligne18/ligne18_plan.gd, lots/ligne18/plan.json, made by godot/lots/ligne18/tool/build_plan.py, frozen): the axis, straight through the stations, the rails' profile, the piers' places, the stations' frames and levels. Its children: ligne18-viaduc (the ramp, the spans and piers, the tracks along the whole line), ligne18-polytechnique and ligne18-universite (each station over its zone, u -45..45, and its grounds up to the roads round it). Christ de Saclay is outside the map.
